title: OIML V 2:1984/Cor.1:1987
description: Corrigendum (Cor.1:1987) to the first edition of the International Vocabulary of Basic and General Terms in Metrology (VIM V 2:1984). The corrigendum modifies 3 concepts (1.01 quantity — Note 2 extended with 'also called quantities of the same kind'; 4.10 analogue measuring instrument — definition 'output or display' changed to 'output and/or display'; 5.23 limits of error — preferred designation extended to 'limits of (permissible) error'). The remaining 135 concepts are textually identical to V 2:1984 and are linked via 'equivalent' edges. Superseded by the 1993 second edition.
